Air India Flight Drops 300 Feet Due to Turbulence, 14 Injured

An Air India flight from Phuket to Delhi dropped 300 feet due to turbulence, injuring 14 passengers. The incident occurred on a flight that was experiencing severe turbulence. The plane's altitude was affected by changes in air pressure and wind patterns. The airline is reviewing its safety procedures to prevent similar incidents.
